title: The derived coherator is right adjoint to termwise quasi-coherent inclusion
statement: Let $T$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme]. On its small Zariski ringed site let $\mathcal M_T=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_T)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and let $\mathcal A_T$ be its full category of quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent], with the induced abelian structure [lem-sfb-qcoh-grothendieck-generators]. The inclusion $i_T:\mathcal A_T\to\mathcal M_T$ has an additive left exact right adjoint $q_T:\mathcal M_T\to\mathcal A_T$, called the coherator. The total right derived functor $C_T=Rq_T:D(\mathcal M_T)\to D(\mathcal A_T)$ exists on unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. It is right adjoint to the termwise derived inclusion $I_T:D(\mathcal A_T)\to D(\mathcal M_T)$ [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. These are triangulated functors, with their canonical integer-shift comparisons; the unit $e_T:\operatorname{id}\to C_TI_T$ and counit $d_T:I_TC_T\to\operatorname{id}$ commute with those comparisons. The adjunction is the one induced from $i_T\dashv q_T$: for a complex $B$ of $\mathcal A_T$ and a K-injective complex $J$ of $\mathcal M_T$, its Hom bijection on their localizations sends a chain map $i_TB\to J$ to its termwise underived adjunct $B\to q_TJ$.

source.place: Tag 08D6, perfect-section-coherator, opening paragraphs through the derived adjunction; underived existence is Tag 077P, properties-proposition-coherator (2). The shift and representative normalization specifies the induced derived adjunction.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-qcoh-grothendieck-generators], $\mathcal A_T$ is Grothendieck abelian and $i_T$ is exact and preserves every small colimit. Apply [lem-sfb-grothendieck-colimit-functor-right-adjoint] to $F=i_T$ and $\mathcal B=\mathcal M_T$. The ambient module category is locally small in the fixed sheaf universe. This gives $i_T\dashv q_T$, with natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(i_TA,M)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(A,q_TM)$. Thus $q_T$ is the underived coherator. This is the representability construction of Tag 077P(2), packaged by the general functor form of Tag 07D7; no finiteness condition on $T$ is required.

source.place: Tag 077P, proposition-coherator, proof of (2); its input is injectives.tex Tag 07D7, lemma-grothendieck-brown.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-limits], $q_T$ preserves finite limits, so it is left exact. It preserves the zero object and finite products. Under the canonical product comparisons its images of the biproduct projections are the projections; its images of the injections are therefore the injections, since their components are identities and zero maps. Hence it preserves diagonal and codiagonal maps. Applying it to $f+g=\nabla\circ(f\oplus g)\circ\Delta$ gives $q_T(f+g)=q_T(f)+q_T(g)$. Thus it is additive.

source.place: Tag 08D6, section-coherator, opening: the coherator is left exact as a right adjoint; the additive biproduct argument is expanded here.

proof.text: The category $\mathcal M_T$ is Grothendieck abelian by [lem-pc-scheme-modules-grothendieck-abelian]. Consequently [lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective] supplies unbounded K-injective resolutions in it. The functor $K(q_T)$ is triangulated by [lem-trf-additive-homotopy-triangulated], and localization $Q_{\mathcal A_T}$ is triangulated by [lem-pur-homotopy-category-triangulated]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived] to $Q_{\mathcal A_T}K(q_T)$: its total right derived functor $C_T$ exists and $C_T(Q_{\mathcal M_T}J)\cong Q_{\mathcal A_T}(q_TJ)$ for every K-injective $J$. This is $Rq_T$ with the comparison of [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. Since $i_T$ is exact, [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] gives the triangulated termwise derived inclusion $I_T$, including its canonical shifts.

source.place: Tags 014X (lemma-additive-exact-homotopy-category), 070Y (lemma-K-injective-defined), and 070K (lemma-enough-K-injectives-implies); Tag 015F for the exact inclusion; used in perfect.tex Tag 08D6.

proof.text:
For a K-injective complex $J$ of $\mathcal M_T$, [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective] applies to the exact left adjoint $i_T$ and shows that $q_TJ$ is K-injective in $\mathcal A_T$. For every complex $B$ of $\mathcal A_T$, the two applications of [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived] and the termwise adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] give natural bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal M_T)}(I_TQB,QJ)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal M_T)}(i_TB,J)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A_T)}(B,q_TJ)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A_T)}(QB,C_TQJ).$$
The middle map sends $[f]$ to $[q_T(f)\circ\eta_B]$, where $\eta$ is the underived unit. The first map is the termwise representative isomorphism $I_TQB\cong Q(i_TB)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] followed by the inverse of the localization bijection; the last is localization followed by the K-injective derived comparison $Q_{\mathcal A_T}(q_TJ)\cong C_TQJ$ from step 3. Every ambient derived object has such a representative $J$; morphisms between such representatives are homotopy classes by the same Hom lemma. Thus these bijections are natural on both derived categories and define $I_T\dashv C_T$. They give exactly the requested chain-map normalization.

source.place: Tags 08BJ (lemma-adjoint-preserve-K-injectives), 070I (lemma-K-injective), and 09T5 (lemma-derived-adjoint-functors); explicit Hom calculation realizing the adjunction in perfect.tex Tag 08D6.

proof.text: The adjunction in step 4 is induced from $i_T\dashv q_T$ on K-injective representatives, so [lem-sp-canonical-right-derived-adjunction-shift] applies: $i_T$ is additive and exact, $q_T$ is additive, and $\mathcal M_T$ has K-injective resolutions. It says that its actual unit $e_T$ and counit $d_T$ commute with the fixed canonical integer-shift comparisons of $I_T$ and $C_T$. Since $I_T$ is triangulated by step 3, [lem-sf-triangulated-right-adjoint] now shows that $C_T$ is triangulated with this same shift structure. This proves all the claimed compatibilities.
